format: IEEE float32 stereo WAV; no dither
matching: One constant gain per file targets .025 RMS, capped at .8 peak. No gain cap: quiet raw files remain float32; gain is recorded. Level matching is a listening aid, not processing in the instrument.
limitations: No human audition or physical iPhone Safari. Event windows can overlap; measured source events are used, including actual CUTS EVENT output. Energy coordinates are normalized, not joules. Synthetic room/machine samples. No perceptual conclusion from RMS alone.
